mentions.name: Reverie
mentions.description: This sleep tracking app rates sleep quality, tracks sleep debt, and tracks how factors like workout timing, coffee time, and AC temperature influence sleep. Version 2.0 (in app review) adds recovery scoring based on sleep HRV and heart rate, plus strain tracking.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://startreverie.com

Rates your sleep, tracks sleep debt, and tracks how workout timing, coffee time, AC temperature, etc influence your sleep.

2.0 is in review - adds support for recovery (based on sleep HRV, HR), and strain.
